profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Titan HST
profile.summary:
My current role requires a strong skill set as a team member, a full stack developer, a technical architect, a consultant and a leader. Throughout my career I have worked with some amazing software developers and gained a wide array of skills that allow me to recommend an optimal architectural plan for any application at the cheapest price. I have worked with many organizations spanning a wide range of industries including: point-of-sale, e-commerce, politics, news, food & beverage, bluetooth hardware, sports, product distribution and medical fields.

	One aspect of my job is to follow current trends and be familiar with as many languages, packages and architecture patterns that are being widely used today. Some of the technologies in my preferred tech stack include: Swift, Typescript, React, Golang, Unity, Jenkins, SQL, AWS, Docker and Kubernetes.

	When I am not working I enjoy spending time with my wife, tinkering with new technologies I hear about and researching current best practices and software trends. I have a strong love for music and enjoy composing, collecting unique instruments and expanding my vinyl collection.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved iOS application through development of new features, maintenance and testing
• Improved mesh networking solution for mobile and IoT platforms using BLE and Wifi protocols
• Designed and developed two generations of IoT products for mass production that provide multiple services such as: extending the range of our mesh networking solution, scanning and monitoring nearby beacons, advertising iBeacon and Eddystone signals, tracking nearby assets and monitoring population density for COVID-19 social distancing
• Manage outsourcing of hardware manufacturing and design
• Improved React web application through development of new features, maintenance and testing
• Developed internal tools such as: mapping tools, hardware preparation tools, scanning tools and automated scripts
• Setup configuration of all JIRA/Confluence projects and manage all configuration updates
• Assist in user interface and user experience design of all platforms
• Assist in hiring process for technical recruitment
• Assist in user interface and user experience design of all platforms
• Assist in technical documentation of all platforms
• Assist in customer support of all platforms
• Assist in managing AWS infrastructure and monitoring logs, improved CI/CD process for iOS and IoT services
• Provide leadership, guidance and various mentoring duties to team members

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed over 15+ applications (Front-end, Mobile, Back-end, DevOps)
• Evaluated and audited over 10+ applications for potential investment
• Consulted, planned, developed & maintain multiple iOS applications
• Consulted, planned, developed & maintain multiple APIs and Internal tools (Node.js, React.js)
• Consulted, planned, developed & maintain all CI/CD operations (Docker, Jenkins, AWS)
• Managed configuration and maintenance of multiple MongoDB, Redis and PostgreSQL databases
• Consulted on the setup and assisted with the management and maintenance of all AWS Services
• Improved internal documentation procedures using tools such as Swagger/OpenAPI3.0 and Postman
• Assisted in Project Management and Developer Administration as a team leader
• Assisted with Quality Assurance Management 
• Improved hiring practices; developed code challenges for multiple job roles
• Presented multiple Lunch & Learn/Brown-Bag events on best practices and common development strategies
• Formed a cross-functional team for developing documentation for best practices, procedures and project plans across all development disciplines 
• Assisted in the company-wide migration from a Waterfall software development methodology to Agile software development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked on 5+ applications (iOS, Titanium, Wordpress, PHP)
• Consulted, planned, developed & maintained multiple iOS & Titanium applications
• Assisted in API design and development in PHP
• Evaluated multiple applications for potential clients

positions.title: iOS Software Developer
positions.description:
• Enhanced the current product through the development of new features & bug fixes
• Worked closely with server-side developers to create custom enterprise software 
• Participated in team brainstorms, design discussions, prototypes, & code review
• Translated photoshop documents into iOS user interfaces
• Developed a JavaScript library, Ruby & Bash scripts for automated iOS testing through TeamCity
• Created the users guide for the Order Entry iPad App & ECM web application
• Responsible for updating release notes & shipping to the app store every two weeks
• Assisted in documentation & coordination of training procedures for support technicians

positions.title: IT Manager / Associate Appraiser
positions.description:
• Managed all IT infrastructure and technical related duties
• Setup computer network & troubleshoot software/hardware issues on a weekly basis
• Inspect properties to evaluate final estimated value, condition & functionality
• Prepare detailed reports & sketch property diagrams using Wintotal Aurora Software
